newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in a very thin trade on Wednesday and Dalmatinska Banka led the decliners.
* Six of 14 active issues fell, four rose and four were unchanged.
* Volume was halved at 5,966 shares and turnover was also down to mere 2.3 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer was Karlovacka Pivovara brewery rising 15 kuna to 240 selling 109 shares.
* Leading decliner was Dalmatinska Banka which lost 70 kuna to 390 with 50 shares changing hands.
* Most actively traded stock was food company Podravka which gained five kuna to 310 kuna on volume of 2,825 units. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
